''I Giallorossi'' (The Red-Yellows) | fullname = Unione Sportiva Catanzaro 1929{{cite web|url=http://www.uscatanzaro.net/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=24489|title=UsCatanzaro.net – Il Catanzaro Calcio torna US|last=UsCatanzaro.net|website=uscatanzaro.net|date=6 August 2011|access-date=2 April 2018}} | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1929}} | owner = Unione Sportiva Catanzaro 1929 S.r.l.[http://www.uscatanzaro1929.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=3&Itemid=2 La Societa'] | chairman = Floriano Noto | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Giorgio Gorgone]] | league = {{Italian football updater|Catanzaro}} | season = {{Italian football updater|Catanzaro2}} | position = {{Italian football updater|Catanzaro3}} | current = | ground = [[Stadio Nicola Ceravolo]] | capacity = 14,650 | website = {{URL|https://www.uscatanzaro1929.com/|uscatanzaro1929.com}} | pattern_la1 = _catanzaro2021h | pattern_la2 = _catanzaro2021a | pattern_la3 = _catanzaro2021t | pattern_b1 = _catanzaro2021h | pattern_b2 = _catanzaro2021a | pattern_b3 = _catanzaro2021t | pattern_ra1 = _catanzaro2021h | pattern_ra2 = _catanzaro2021a | pattern_ra3 = _catanzaro2021t | pattern_sh1 = _catanzaro2021h | pattern_sh2 = _catanzaro2021a | pattern_sh3 = _catanzaro2021t | pattern_so1 = _catanzaro2021h | pattern_so2 = _catanzaro2021a | pattern_so3 = _catanzaro2021t | leftarm1 = FFFF00 | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | leftarm3 = 000000 | body1 = FFFF00 | body2 = FFFFFF | body3 = 000000 | rightarm1 = FFFF00 | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = 000000 | shorts1 = FF0000 | shorts2 = FF0000 | shorts3 = 000000 | socks1 = FF0000 | socks2 = FFFFFF | socks3 = 000000 | image = US Catanzaro 1929 crest.svg | image_size = 250px }} '''Unione Sportiva Catanzaro 1929''', or simply '''Catanzaro''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Catanzaro]], Calabria, Italy, that competes in [[Serie B]], the second tier of [[Football in Italy|Italian football]], following a 17-year absence. The club was initially formed with the merger of two local clubs in 1927 before being officially founded in 1929.{{Cite web|url=http://www.catanzaronelpallone.net/la-storia-giallorossa/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150522140352/http://www.catanzaronelpallone.net/la-storia-giallorossa/|url-status=usurped|archive-date=22 May 2015|title=LA STORIA GIALLOROSSA – catanzaronelpallone|date=22 May 2015|access-date=19 October 2019}} Since then, the club has primarily competed in the lower divisions of the national competitions and has been re-founded twice, once in 2006 and again in 2011, both for [[Financial crisis|financial]] reasons. Since its foundation, the official colours of the club have been red and yellow. The team has used these colours predominantly in their kits, frequently playing in either all-red kits with yellow trims or in red and yellow stripes. The club's official emblem is the [[golden eagle]], in honour of the city's coat of arms. The team plays its home matches at the [[Stadio Nicola Ceravolo]], which was built in 1919 and is the oldest sports facility in [[Calabria]]. In its history, Catanzaro has played seven seasons in [[Serie A]], five of which were consecutive. The best performance in Serie A was a seventh place finish in [[1981–82 Serie A|1981–82]] and an eighth-place finish in [[1980–81 Serie A|1980–81]]. The club has won seven championships since its foundation. Six of these were in the third tier (one in [[Prima Divisione]], two in [[Serie C]], and three in [[Serie C1]]). The final championship was won in [[IV Serie]] in 1953. This year, the club was also national title holders after winning the [[Serie D#Scudetto Serie D|Scudetto IV Serie]]. At youth level, the club won the Dante Berretti Trophy of Serie C in 1991–1992. In the [[Coppa Italia]], Catanzaro's best results were runners-up in [[1965–66 Coppa Italia|1965–66]], and semi-finalists in [[1978–79 Coppa Italia|1978–79]] and [[1981–82 Coppa Italia|1981–82]]. On 30 May 2018, the club, which had already used the historic logo since 2011, announced the return of the old name "Unione Sportiva Catanzaro", with the final addition of "1929".{{Cite web|url=https://www.catanzaroinforma.it/notizia113215/Us-Catanzaro-slitta-annuncio-di-Auteri-ma-niente-panico.html|title=US Catanzaro: slitta annuncio di Auteri ma niente panico|date=30 May 2018|website=CatanzaroInforma.it|access-date=19 October 2019}}{{Cite web|url=http://www.catanzarosport24.it/in-primo-piano/e-ritornata-l-us-catanzaro-1929-14012|title=E' ritornata l'U.S. Catanzaro 1929|website=Catanzaro Sport 24|language=it|access-date=19 October 2019}}"}}
